description: Make self a real reflexive noun rather than a generic object whose printable description is literally 'you'

replacements.old:
<OBJECT ME
	(IN GLOBAL-OBJECTS)
	(SYNONYM ME MYSELF SELF CRETIN)
	(DESC "you")
	(FLAGS ACTORBIT)
	(ACTION CRETIN-FCN)>
replacements.new:
<OBJECT ME
	(IN GLOBAL-OBJECTS)
	(SYNONYM ME MYSELF SELF YOU CRETIN)
	(DESC "yourself")
	(FLAGS ACTORBIT)
	(ACTION CRETIN-FCN)>

replacements.old:
(<VERB? MAKE>
		<TELL "Only you can do that." CR>)
replacements.new:
(<VERB? COMMAND>
		<TELL "You are already in command of yourself." CR>)
	       (<AND <VERB? PUT PUT-ON> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME>>
		<TELL "You cannot put yourself ">
		<COND (<VERB? PUT-ON> <TELL "on ">)
		      (T <TELL "into ">)>
		<TELL "the " D ,PRSI "." CR>)
	       (<VERB? MAKE>
		<TELL "Only you can do that." CR>)
